findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "list_erp_partners" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Lists the firms and independent consultants in ProjectThunder's ERP partner directory, optionally filtered by ERP (for example Business Central or Dynamics NAV)…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_page, get_contact_info, list_pages · Private data: get_contact_info, list_erp_partners · Public sink: get_contact_info, list_articles, scan_website.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_page, get_contact_info, list_pages · Private data: get_contact_info, list_erp_partners · Public sink: get_contact_info, list_articles, scan_website

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
